task_instance: Migrate a small sample Netlify site to Vercel format: convert its netlify.toml/_redirects/_headers into a single vercel.json (redirects + headers) and convert a classic Netlify Function (event handler) into a Vercel api/ serverless function (req,res), preserving the publish dir as public/.
evidence: Verified Node v22.22.0, npm 10.9.4, jq 1.7 present; Vercel CLI reported 'not installed'. Created input sample Netlify project under netlify-src/ (package.json, netlify.toml with a 301 redirect, public/_redirects with a 301 and a splat 302, public/_headers with X-Frame-Options/X-Content-Type-Options, public/index.html, and netlify/functions/health.js using the classic exports.handler(event) signature). Performed the skill's Step 1 (configuration mapping) and Step 2 (function migration) with file/shell tools only, producing vercel-target/ containing vercel.json, api/health.js, public/index.html, package.json. Verification: `jq -e . vercel-target/vercel.json` => VALID JSON with redirects count 2 and headers count 1 matching the mapped Netlify rules. Ran the converted function with verify_fn.js using a Vercel-Node-style res stub (setHeader/status/json): statusCode=200, content-type=application/json, body={"status":"ok","name":"acme"}, FUNCTION_PARITY_OK=true, process exit 0. Files produced: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r202/vercel-target/vercel.json, .../vercel-target/api/health.js, .../vercel-target/public/index.html, .../vercel-target/package.json, .../verify_fn.js. The offline conversion deliverable (two of the skill's five Output bullets: configuration mapped from source platform, functions converted to Vercel format) exists and is verified. The remaining account-bound phases (vercel link, vercel env add, vercel domains add, DNS cutover, live preview deploy) were outside this minimal instance and would require the Vercel CLI plus a logged-in account and DNS control, which the safety rules forbid; they were not attempted.
